name: Tehtris EDR
description: Tehtris XDR/EDR integration: host isolation, file quarantine and restore, plus read-only endpoint security posture (inventory detail, isolation status, process listing, system information, live network activity, installed software and file details). Local fork of the Splunk-published Tehtris app v1.0.1, extended for UC16.

actions.description: Validate the asset configuration for connectivity using supplied configuration

from_date.description: Seconds since EPOCH in UTC timezone of the starting date from when fetch the events.

to_date.description: Seconds since EPOCH in UTC timezone of the ending date to fetch the events. Leave blank to fetch events until now

limit.description: Page size used while paging through events, 1 to 1000 (Tehtris' maximum). Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of events to skip before starting to collect the result set.

filter_id.description: The Filter ID used to retrieve events, if no filterId is specified in query the first filter Id store with API Key is used.

actions.description: Send a host to the isolation module
actions.verbose: The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used). When several endpoints share the hostname (for example a re-installed agent) the action is refused and lists their uuids. summary.applied is true when Tehtris accepted the request for a connected agent, and false when the agent is offline and the host will be isolated once it reconnects. Confirm the result with get isolation status.

hostname.description: Hostname to be sent for isolation

example_values: Sent the request to isolate ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.verbose: The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used). When several endpoints share the hostname (for example a re-installed agent) the action is refused and lists their uuids. summary.applied is true when Tehtris accepted the request for a connected agent, and false when the agent is offline and the host will be released once it reconnects. Confirm the result with get isolation status.

hostname.description: Hostname to be removed from isolation

example_values: Sent the request to release from isolation ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.description: Get process tree from a process

create_time.description: Local created time of the process

pid.description: Database id of the process to use to build the tree

actions.description: Set an endpoint's tags (may replace its existing tags)
actions.verbose: The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used). Warning: Tehtris takes one tag string per call and does not document whether it replaces or adds to the endpoint's existing tags, so treat this action as able to overwrite them: read the current tags with get host detail first and include any you want to keep. Refused when several endpoints share the hostname.

tag.description: Tag string in Tehtris' 'XXX_tags' pattern (the tenant trigram, an underscore, then the tags); may replace the endpoint's existing tags

example_values: Set tags 'ABC_isolated' on ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2); this may have replaced the endpoint's existing tags

actions.description: Create new application policy based on sha256
actions.verbose: Creates one application policy with a single Sha256 rule. Tehtris scopes an application policy by appliance: the request carries appliance ids and no per-endpoint field, so the policy applies to every endpoint on the appliances the listed hosts connect to, not only to those hosts. The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used).

order.description: Order the rule applies to a matching binary

example_values: Successfully posted new app policy for ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2

actions.description: Get the current EDR isolation state of a host
actions.verbose: Reads the isolation flag for the host (Tehtris' IsolationStatus reply, status boolean). When no state comes back (HTTP 204) summary.isolated is null and the payload is in raw_json. Treat null as unknown, never as not isolated.

hostname.description: Hostname to read isolation status for

actions.description: Get EDR inventory detail for a host
actions.verbose: Exposes the inventory lookup the other host-scoped actions perform internally, returning every endpoint named exactly hostname (a re-installed agent keeps its hostname under a new uuid), most recently seen first; the summary describes that first one. Fields follow Tehtris' inventory schema; os and versions are free-form objects, available in raw_json. When no endpoint has that exact name the action still succeeds, with total_hosts 0 and the not-found reason as its message, so a playbook can tell 'no such host' from a failed call; every other host-scoped action fails on an unknown host.

hostname.description: Hostname to look up in the EDR inventory

actions.description: List processes seen on a host over a time window
actions.verbose: Unlike list processes, which builds a tree around a seed pid and requires one, this action returns a listing and needs no seed. Bound it with time_from/time_to and limit. Tehtris serves this listing through a cursor and the action reads its first page only, so limit caps the result. Fields follow Tehtris' process schema; raw_json carries the untouched record.

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return

actions.description: Get the operating system details of a host
actions.verbose: Live OS details from the EDR agent: name, type (desktop/server), architecture, release and version. Tehtris' reference lists only 'windows' as a name, so a host on another OS may answer HTTP 501 (not implemented on the endpoint). The payload is also available in raw_json.

hostname.description: Hostname to fetch system information for

actions.description: Get live network activity (netstat) for a host
actions.verbose: Live network activity from the EDR agent (Tehtris' netstat call). Each reply names its columns but Tehtris' reference does not list them, so every row is returned with those column names as keys and also in raw_json. Needs the agent to be connected.

hostname.description: Hostname to fetch network activity for

actions.description: Get hashes, version and signatures of a file on a host
actions.verbose: Reads a file's details from the EDR agent (Tehtris' FileInfoData): hashes, original file name, file and product version, and code signatures with their validity. Useful to check a file before quarantining it. When Tehtris returns nothing for the path (HTTP 204), the action succeeds with summary.file_found false. A live call: the EDR agent must be connected, otherwise Tehtris answers 504.

path.description: Full path of the file on the host

actions.description: List the software installed on a host
actions.verbose: The software list from the EDR agent. Each reply names its columns but Tehtris' reference does not list them, so every row is returned with those column names as keys and also in raw_json. A live call: the EDR agent must be connected, otherwise Tehtris answers 504.

actions.description: List the files in quarantine on a host
actions.verbose: One record per quarantined file, carrying its quarantinePath: the path Tehtris stored the file under, which is what restore file takes (not the file's original path). A live call: the EDR agent must be connected, otherwise Tehtris answers 504.

hostname.description: Hostname to list quarantined files for

actions.description: Move a file on a host into Tehtris quarantine
actions.verbose: The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used). Refused when several endpoints share the hostname. summary.applied is true when Tehtris accepted the request for a connected agent (HTTP 204), false when the agent is offline and the task is queued (HTTP 202). A 409 means Tehtris refused the request because of a conflict. Undo it with list quarantined files then restore file: the restore takes the file's path in quarantine, not this path. A live call: the EDR agent must be connected, otherwise Tehtris answers 504.

path.description: Full path of the file to quarantine

notification.description: On Windows, a notification shown to the endpoint user about the remediation (Tehtris does not document the value format; leave blank to send none)

example_values: Sent the request to quarantine C:\Users\asmith\invoice.exe on ws-finance-01 (uuid ffdf773d-b124-4387-b772-a87ec08640c2)

actions.description: Restore a quarantined file on a host
actions.verbose: The hostname must match an enrolled endpoint exactly (Tehtris' inventory search matches substrings, so only an exact, case-insensitive match is used). Refused when several endpoints share the hostname. quarantine_path is the path the file has in quarantine, as returned by list quarantined files (quarantinePath) - not the file's original path. summary.restored_path is where Tehtris put the file back. summary.applied is false when the agent is offline and the task is queued (HTTP 202). A live call: the EDR agent must be connected, otherwise Tehtris answers 504.

quarantine_path.description: The file's path in quarantine, from 'list quarantined files' (quarantinePath)
